posts.title: My daughter at ninety days: Patron of the arts
posts.description: Tropical Forest with Monkeys by Henry Rousseau It’s 7:20 in the morning and Aranya, all of three months old, is asleep beside me. Moments ago, she farted, made a sad face, and looked around in abject hopelessness. If Abhimanyu learned warfare in the womb, Aranya has learned melodrama. posts.title: My Daughter at thirty days: Adorable little gundumani
posts.description: I'm doing a flowstate with Aranya sleeping beside me. She’s such an adorable little gundumani. She makes the funniest chirping sounds while sleeping in her bassinet. They sound interchangeably like the sparrows outside our window in Versova and Tweety bird from the Sylvester and Tweety Mysteries. Aranya was born a black belt in kung-fu. posts.title: Collection of Past Pain
posts.description: When in pain, one of two things will happen - either the pain dies, or you do. 12 August 2022, Versova Beach The answer to all maladies is the sea. I was despondent before I decided to pay the beach a visit. The waves were particularly strong. They lashed against the rocks. With difficulty, I prized my eyes off a kissing couple.
